text.description_html:
Acorn PS6YP, Hand Painted Woodland Ceramic Cabinet Knob

Acorn's Woodland Ceramic Cabinet Knob is a beautiful way to bring the outside inside. Hand painted on ceramic, it is available in 5 colors, each of is a true work of art. Measuring 1-7/8" squared it is large enough to make a true impression. Brighten up your home with arty style by adding a unique and colorful touch to any cabinet or drawer!

Features of the Woodland Ceramic Cabinet Knob:

  • Length: 1-7/8" squared
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
